chapter.heading: The Lord the Strength of His PeopleA Song of Ascents.
chapter.v:
Those who
trust in the LordAre like Mount Zion,Which cannot be moved, but abides forever.

As the
mountains surround Jerusalem,So the Lord surrounds His peopleFrom this time forth and forever.

For the
scepter of wickedness shall not restOn the land allotted to the righteous,Lest the righteous reach out their hands to iniquity.

Do good,
O Lord, to those who are good,And to those who are upright in their hearts.

As for
such as turn aside to their crooked ways,The Lord shall lead them awayWith the workers of iniquity.Peace be upon Israel!
